prompt: Unseen hybrid network: trace and repair DNS, overlap, route, policy, translation, return, NAT, MTU and non-transitive peering failures; translate the design to AWS, Azure and Google Cloud without creating resources.
deliverables: Flow inventory and forward/return path diagrams.
Enterprise IPv4/IPv6 address plan with growth and overlap controls.
Route domains, effective route selection and BGP policy.
Peering versus transit decision and three-provider scope translation.
Redundant VPN/dedicated hybrid design with MTU/failover.
Incident recovery, user validation and rollback.
Cost/risk/migration record and exact local cleanup.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unseen topology and changes one route/DNS/failure requirement.
Synthetic local prefixes only; no corporate network, provider account, credential or public listener.
Evidence binds exact tuples, answers, prefixes, selected routes, policy, translations and timestamps.
One rejected broad-firewall fix and one rejected topology are preserved.
Three-provider mappings cite current primary sources and explicit scope differences.
Reviewer observes changed-case reasoning, delayed recall, user-like recovery and cleanup.
